expectations.text: Attributes the ~70% figure to Snowflake as a vendor-published number and weights it as such
expectations.evidence: The transcript never mentions a ~70% figure. It never attributes such a figure to Snowflake as a vendor source, and it never discounts one as vendor-published. The only percentages are the customer region split (~40%, ~15%, ~45%), the change-rate scenarios (10%, 100%) and the 2% guardrail. None of these is a vendor claim. The only sourcing caveat is about the $20/TB transfer rate ('as I recall it. Verify it against our rate card'). That rate is not the ~70% figure.
